text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ...Dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhhhh!! I loooost...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Still, but... but...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I...!! I can still get even stronger...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my all because I wanted to win 
the Derby!! I gave everything to beat 
Taishin and Hayahide, no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I lost, and it hurts like 
hell...! But because it hurts, I know I 
can still get stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Frustration and all, I'll take it in 
stride!! I'm gonna go all out, even more 
than before! Yaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH!! Next up is the Kikuka 
Shooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Ticket... Even after losing the race she 
dreamed of for so long... she's already 
looking straight ahead.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (—She really is dazzling, that girl.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket and Taishin... The growth they've 
shown since awakening their abilities is 
astonishing...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I must reconstruct the formula... 
immediately!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Taishin, that was a great run!
Taishin, that was a great run!

text_block_list.text:
True, you missed out on the win, but you 
still made the board. That alone is a 
remarkable achievement.
Besides—
choice_data_list: The Classics aren't over just yet!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. I know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll never let them call me someone who 
lost here and was done for.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is where... I will win!!

Up next is the final leg of the Triple 
Crown, the Kikuka Sho.

To seize glory the next time around, she 
vowed to build her strength once more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —That's right, I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
As long as I win the race. I'm sure even I 
can...
